data.one_liner: Dart SDK for working with Selective Disclosure JSON Web Tokens (SD-JWT)
data.what_it_does: Implements the IETF SD-JWT specification allowing issuers to create JWTs with selectively disclosable claims, holders to present specific claims, and verifiers to validate them.
use_when: You need to implement privacy-preserving data sharing using Selective Disclosure JSON Web Tokens.
Your application acts as an Issuer, Holder, or Verifier within an SD-JWT workflow.
avoid_when: You only require standard JWT encoding and decoding without selective disclosure features.
strengths: Supports multiple signing algorithms including ES256, ES256K, RS256, HS256, and EdDSA.
Provides built-in key binding to prevent unauthorized presentations.
weaknesses: Niche standard that may require understanding complex IETF specifications.
Custom signers, hashers, and verifiers must be written manually if you use uncommon cryptographic algorithms.
